proof_scope: Seven-slide source contracts plus three real Python demonstrations on synthetic data. No human or Google Slides approval is implied.

claims.proves: Canonical/generated manifests agree, notes cover 36 minutes, source and breakpoint bindings match files, and real runtime demonstrations reproduce identity, typed rejection and report-last output.
claims.does_not_prove: Audience legibility, visible VS Code rehearsal, Google Slides import fidelity, human approval, or production scale.

cases.name: seven-slide-source-contracts
command: cd .. && uv run pytest -q tests/test_pitch_contract.py security/tests/test_claim_surface.py

cases.name: live-alias-and-publication-demonstrations
command: cd .. && PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/pitch_debug_demo.py identity && PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/pitch_debug_demo.py publication

stdout_contains: REJECTED: JSON true mutated to integer 1

cases.name: real-publication-breakpoint-readback
command: cd .. && PYTHONPATH=src "$DEBUGGER_SKILL/run.sh" break src/anonymization_trial/pipeline.py:205 --local report_path --local output_corpus --watch "report_path.exists()" --watch "output_corpus.exists()" --allow-watch-eval --out "$ARTIFACT_DIR/eval-publication-breakpoint.json" -- python scripts/pitch_debug_demo.py publication && python3 -c 'import os,json; r=json.load(open(os.environ["ARTIFACT_DIR"]+"/eval-publication-breakpoint.json")); assert r["hit_count"] == 1; w=r["hits"][0]["watches"]; assert w["report_path.exists()"]["value"] == "False"; assert w["output_corpus.exists()"]["value"] == "True"; print("BREAKPOINT_READBACK_PASS")'
